findings.problem: English "you" can also be plural, and in Latin America the informal plural is ustedes ("esto es para ustedes"), so "informal" alone doesn't rule out a second right answer.
findings.fix: hint: informal, one person, after a preposition

back.es: you (informal singular object of a preposition, as in para ti, de ti)

note: Since this is the word's only card, the editor could mention somewhere that after con the form is contigo, not con ti, and that voseo regions say para vos.
